individuals.title: Newcomers from Sub-Saharan Africa feel safe publishing
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of

individuals.title: Moderators notice quality improvements and configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them.

individuals.title: Newcomers feel safe and motivated making changes
individuals.quote: will feel safe and motivated making changes to Wikipedia

individuals.title: Visual editor does not show policies
individuals.quote: The trouble is that the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow.

individuals.title: Inexperienced volunteers become frustrated by reverts
individuals.quote: become disappointed and frustrated when the good-faith change(s) they arrived to the wiki seeking to make are undone (read: reverted)

individuals.title: Wikipedia projects struggle to diversify volunteers
individuals.quote: struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations

individuals.title: Sub-Saharan Africa underrepresented among editors
individuals.quote: people from Sub-Saharan Africa represent only 1% of active unique editors

individuals.quote: relatively limited and straightforward set of rules in order to

individuals.quote: A minimum of one new paragraph of text is added to the article someone is editing

individuals.quote: prompt them to do so

individuals.quote: To decide how – if at all – this change impacted volunteer disruption and edit quality

individuals.title: Increase quality of edits from Sub-Saharan Africa
individuals.quote: Increase the quality of edits newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa publish in the main namespace

individuals.title: Multi-Check increased edits with references
individuals.quote: Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference

individuals.title: Reference Check increased constructive edits with references
individuals.quote: to publish a new content edit that includes a reference and is constructive (not reverted within 48 hours)

individuals.title: Revert rate fell 15.7% after siderail change
individuals.quote: The revert rate of new content edits where Reference Check was activated decreased by **15.7%**.

individuals.title: Reference Check increased constructive retention 16%
individuals.quote: 16 percent more likely to return to make a non-reverted edit in their second month

individuals.title: Reference Check reduced revert rate 8.6%
individuals.quote: New content edit revert rate **decreased by 8.6%** if Reference Check was available.

individuals.title: Edit completion rate fell 10% with Reference Check
individuals.quote: Overall, there was a **10% decrease** in edit completion rate for edits where Reference Check was shown.

individuals.title: Edit completion rate drastically decreases
individuals.quote: Edit completion rate drastically decreases

individuals.title: Blocks increase
individuals.quote: Blocks increase | Proportion of contributors blocked after publishing an edit where Edit Check was shown is significantly higher

individuals.quote: Edit Check is too resource intensive to scale
